current_prompt.body:
READ the item sequence and bin capacity C = 10
APPLY First Fit algorithm to allocate items into bins
DETERMINE the optimal bin packing that minimizes the number of bins for the same items
CALCULATE the difference in bin count between First Fit result and optimal result
EXPLAIN how the arrival order leads to First Fit using more bins
INCLUDE a self-test that checks both packings use each item exactly once and that no bin exceeds capacity
